objective: Assess the PR 3 repair commit a38b600 (range 2e1c021..a38b600, worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-config) for security regressions in the user/project config trust boundary, and confirm the earlier security notes are closed or settled.
scope: The repair diff is in /home/user/holyagent-notes/pr3-repair.diff; source is readable under /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-config.
constraints: Binding maintainer decision: for security-relevant pi features (computer use, T3 device access, the web tools), a false in the user-level ~/.holyagent/config.json is final; a project's .holyagent/config.json can turn them off but never back on. Every other key keeps project-wins.
Both config files are decoded with Effect Schema and onExcessProperty error before merging; a malformed or hostile project config must fail closed, never widen access.
Read-only: no edits, no version-control writes.

criteria.text: A project config cannot re-enable a security-relevant feature the user-level config turned off, on any merge path
The repair introduces no new vulnerability (path handling of the home directory, environment use, error output leaking content)
The earlier security notes are closed or settled by a sound stated choice
